selected_script.angle: Low-risk family rescuer: An absurdly dressed grandmother in a neon ski suit steps in to solve diaper clutter on a baby's nursery door using the Woven Cotton 3-Tier Over the Door Basket.
selected_script.hook: Close-up detail of diapers and wipes cluttered messily on a changing table, spilling onto the floor.

usage_steps_used: Hang the metal hook over the top of a door
Suspend the woven basket assembly by slipping the top rope loop onto the hook
Place items loosely inside the 3 woven basket tiers

script_record.title: Low-Risk Rescuer Over the Door Basket Organizer
script_record.pain_point: Diapers and baby wipes cluttered and falling off a changing table.
script_record.conflict_hook: Nursery clutter hook with a neon-ski-suit grandmother rescuer.
script_record.product_solution: Hang the 3-tier basket over the door to quickly organize baby accessories.

timeline.scene: Close-up of baby diapers and wipes cluttered messily on a nursery changing table, starting to slip off.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An grandmother in a bright neon pink ski suit enters carrying the Natural Jute 3-Tier Over the Door Basket, saying 'Let grandma fix this!'
She hangs the metal hook over the top edge of the door, and slips the top rope loop of the woven basket onto the hook so it hangs vertically.
She neatly places diapers and baby wipes inside the woven basket compartments.
Cut to a bathroom door where shampoo bottles, conditioner, and small towels are placed inside the basket tiers.
Show the fully arranged 3-tier basket hanging neatly on a closed door, holding items stably without exceeding the 16 lbs limit.
Text overlay: 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' with the basket in frame.

script_record.cta: Make your space cleaner and cozier.
